title: TanStack Router
description: Type-safe routing for React with search params and caching.

data.text: TanStack Router provides type-safe routing, search params, and built-in caching for React applications.

data.title: TanStack Router setup

data.text: TanStack Router makes the route tree a first-class, fully typed value, so `useParams` and `useSearch` know exactly which keys exist. It is built around the same data-loading idea as React Router loaders: a route has a loader, and the component reads the result with no loading state in the common case.

data.title: A typed route with a loader

data.text: Search parameters are validated with a schema so `?page=2` becomes a typed number rather than a string. That means filtering and pagination state lives in the URL and is shareable, while the component reads it as a typed value instead of parsing strings by hand.

data.title: Validating search params
When to choose TanStack Router
data.text: Its main advantage over React Router is compile-time safety: a typo in a route name or a param key is a type error, not a runtime blank page. The trade-off is a steeper learning curve and a smaller ecosystem. Name the trade-off honestly rather than claiming it is strictly better.
